figures.title: Relative energy for bilayer FGT under different sliding operations, with respect to the sliding operations of (1/3, 1/3) and (-1/3, 1/3).
Spin-polarized band structure for (a) FGT monolayer and (b) state-1/state-2 bilayer FGT.

(a) The Fe-d orbital projected density of states of state-1 bilayer FGT. Panels (b) and (c) correspond to spin-up and spin-down Fe-d orbital-resolved band structure of state-1 and state-2 FGT. The Fermi level is shifted to 0.
The variation of polarization in (a) state-1 and (b) state-2 bilayer FGT, respectively, as a function of the biaxial in-plane strain.
